items.name: Annuntia Sunday Open 2022

venue.name: [Annuntia-Scholengroep Wijnegem](http://www.annuntia.be/)
venue.details: Venue entrance is in Kerkhofstraat, so not the school's main entrance in Turnhoutsebaan.

items.information:
This is a twin competition together with [Annuntia Saturday Open 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnnuntiaSaturdayOpen2022). You can compete in **only one** of the two competitions.

See [the registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnnuntiaSundayOpen2022#18213-registration) for more info.

items.name: FSUbers 2022

venue.name: [Florida State University](https://www.campus-maps.com/florida-state-university/ssb-student-services-building/)
venue.address: 212 Student Services Building, Florida State University, Tallahassee, FL 32304
venue.details: 2nd Floor, enter door facing the red brick road and walk up the stairwell straight inside

items.information:
For Safety Precautions, we ask that competitors and their **one guest** only be in the venue during the competition's scheduled time. There are many benches and areas around the Campus to explore for other guests who there may not be space for within the venue.

-Please review the **COVID precautions tab** for information regarding the steps taken to increase competitor safety at this competition.
-Please review the **competitor information** tab before the competition.
-Please review **all other** tabs for more information on the competition.

items.name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 31B - Mill Valley 2022

organisers.name: Evan Akira Mann (マンエヴァン朗)

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2tSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--771666707ad993063a3dbe350b42d58d1d336e8f/cubicle-text-logo-black-trans-2500x375.png)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png)
This competition is in partnership with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) and [TheCubicle](https://thecubicle.com).

- Bay Area Speedcubin' is proud to host our first ever competition in beautiful Marin County! The event is only seven miles north of the Golden Gate Bridge, so come join us! **If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.**

- This is a series competition with [Bay Area Speedcubin' 31A - Mill Valley 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BASC31AMillValley2022/). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for *Bay Area Speedcubin' 31A - Mill Valley 2022*, your registration for this competition will be rejected.

- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.

- We are only allowing competitors to bring *at most* 1 guest. If you request more, your registration may be subject to rejection.
